source: This explains why “fits in L2” should be used carefully. A 40 MB tensor and a 50 MB L2 do not guarantee near-perfect reuse. Other data, cache-line mapping, and simultaneous clients matter. Likewise, a working set larger than L2 can still achieve many hits if its hot subset is small or if access patterns repeatedly reuse some regions.
zh: 这解释了为什么应该谨慎使用“适合 L2”。 40 MB 张量和 50 MB L2 并不能保证近乎完美的重用。其他数据、缓存行映射和并发客户端也很重要。同样，如果热子集很小或者访问模式重复重用某些区域，大于 L2 的工作集仍然可以实现许多命中。
